description: Products whose seller states a third-party testing or eligibility claim — HSA/FSA eligible, USP Verified, NSF, Informed Sport, GMP facility, ConsumerLab — matched against the seller's own text and returned with the claim marked seller-stated. Examples: "HSA/FSA eligible vitamin D", "NSF certified protein powder", "USP verified magnesium".
name: find_health_products
title: Find health products by claim
